//: Claude Code PreToolUse hooks: the verification moat for the ts_refactor / show_defun MCP tools. The matcher is a coarse filter (matched against the tool name; written to work whether the name is bare `ts_refactor` or MCP-qualified `mcp__server__ts_refactor`, and under both re.search and re.fullmatch). oracle-gate.py is the real decision: it BLOCKS a refactor whose target repo's declared test oracle (.oracle-gate.json) is red, and ALLOWS reads and green baselines. Paths resolve via CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (plugin layout) with a CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR fallback. Set a generous hook timeout so a slow suite yields the hook's own clean `block: oracle timed out` rather than the harness killing the hook; oracle-gate caps the inner test-command timeout at 280s, below this.
